newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Geotek launches Orlando mobile network.
newsitem.headline: Geotek launches Orlando mobile network.

text.p: Geotek Communications Inc launched its digital wireless communications network in Orlando with services for small- and medium-sized businesses operating fleets of vehicles, the company said in a statement.
The network provides voice and data services, combining the power of a cellular phone, two-way radio, pager, text messager and laptop computer in one.
Orlando is the eighth major metropolitan area in the United States were Geotek serves transport, limousine, courier, field service and construction contracting businesses.

There are more than 29,000 businesses in Orlando that manage a mobile workforce. Nationwide, Geotek estimates there are nearly two million small- and medium-sized businesses operating a combined total of nearly 27 million vehicles daily.
